title: New Feature Request - Purge Old Data
symptom: Large databases tend to slow down the app. A database containing data for about 10 months became very tedious to do some tasks, and eventually the database file became corrupt, possibly due to its size.
fix: The feature is already implemented as 'Glucose Retention' in the 'Less Common Settings'. To keep data from sensors active within 90 days, set it to the theoretical maximum time (e.g., 110 days for G6).
evidence_quote: This feature is already implemented as "Glucose Retention" in the "Less Common Settings".
